paper.title: A Geometric Mutation-Based Genetic Algorithm for Irregular Large-Scale Offshore Wind Farm Layout Optimization

paper_visible: Anholt case identity and irregular planar domain
Poisson disk candidate generation with random in-domain seed, uniform active point, uniform angle, radius in [d,2d], and a maximum-trials input
4.2 MW rated power, 91.5 m hub height, 117 m rotor diameter, and 3 to 25 m/s operating range
air density 1.225 kg/m3, roughness length 0.25 mm, and turbulence intensity 10 percent
Jensen wake model and sum-of-squares overlap
cited_or_same_author_support: Zheng et al. 2024 DOI 10.1007/s42235-024-00498-3 supports the same-author Jensen, integer-layout, roulette, crossover, mutation, and power-curve family but does not supply the Anholt arrays
Davis et al. 2023, target-paper reference 20, is the paper-cited Global Wind Atlas authority but the paper-used twelve tuples are not published
bounded_missing: Poisson seed and maximum trial count

declared_completions: deterministic target-capped Bridson active-list sampling with seed 20250726 and maximum trials 30
twelve frozen joint wind tuples whose probabilities sum to one
rated speed 12 m/s and cubic-in-speed-cubed power ramp
constant thrust coefficient 0.8 and wake expansion 0.05
8760-hour annualization from probability-weighted expected power to AEP in kWh
stable candidate, turbine, and wind-bin summation order

candidate_generation.radius_law: uniform on [d,2d], following the target paper pseudocode literally rather than area-uniform annulus sampling
candidate_generation.cardinality_boundary: The stop-at-180 rule is a declared completion of the paper's approximately 180 statement; it is not asserted to be the author rule.

actual_layout_comparison_boundary: Blocked. No actual-layout coordinate array or actual-layout AEP is emitted, and the paper's up-to-one-percent comparison is not replayed.
claim_boundary: This is a distinct Anholt-structured engineering proxy. It does not reproduce the original Anholt problem or paper results.
